$comment: Central site settings. Empty strings mean 'not supplied yet': the related UI stays hidden. Run `npm run build` after editing. Never put secret keys here; this file is published.

locales.$comment: Spanish is the main language (served at the site root), English lives under /en/.

whatsapp.$comment: Official number from the client (12 Nov 2026) — change it here (digits with country code, no + or spaces) when the business number arrives; every WhatsApp button on the site uses this one value.

hero.$comment: Home hero background. Leave video empty to show the main photo (mundaka-lineup); put an .mp4 file name from public/assets/video to play the drone video instead, with the photo as its poster.

enquiry.$comment: provider: none | formspree | webhook | netlify. 'none' keeps the forms in demo mode: they validate and review but tell the visitor nothing was sent.

payments.$comment: 15 % deposit (or 100 % if the customer prefers) online; prepared but OFF until the Stripe functions are deployed with their secret keys (server/README.md). The browser never sees card data.

legal.$comment: Website owner (LSSI-CE), as given by the client on 12 Nov 2026.

partners.$comment: Brand partners for the footer (e.g. Billabong). Empty = hidden. Each: { "name": "…", "logo": "image name in public/assets/img", "url": "https://…" } (url optional: without it the logo is not a link).

reviews.$comment: Hand-picked testimonials: { "name": "…", "date": "2026-08-14", "rating": 5, "text": { "es": "…", "en": "…" } }. googleUrl = the academy's Google reviews link once the Business Profile exists.
